Executive Summary

A.  The accidental release prevention and emergency response policies at our facilities:

It is the intention of Western management to commit to personal, property and environmental safety to all surrounding life and environment that could possible be affected in any manner by the business conducted at this facility. 

Our Policy is SAFETY FIRST.  The personal safety of each employee of this company is of primary importance.  To the greatest degree possible, management will provide all mechanical and physical facilities required for personal safety.  Our objective is the safety program reducing our exposure to accidents to the absolute minimum. Our goal is ZERO accidents and injuries.

We recognize the responsibilities for safety are shared:
1. The employer accepts responsibility for leadership of the safety program, for its effectiveness, and safeguards providing a safe work place.
2. Employees are responsible for wholehearted cooperation of the safety program, including compliance with all rules, and practicing safety while performing their duties.

Employees are very actively involved in the safety program. Western has monthly safety meetings for all employees. The evacuation plan is practiced regularly. Internal Safety Audits are completed at our facilities to insure compliance with all regulations and safety practices. 

B.  The stationary source and regulated substances handled:

The Western facility is located at 1101 Commercial Avenue in Oakland, NE. Western manufactures Acetylene at this facility.  This process is accomplished through the use of an acetylene generator in which Calcium Carbide is mixed with water to produce acetylene gas which is then purified, dried, and pumped to various size cylinders.  These cylinders are shipped to our other locations for resale.  

Acetylene is pumped from the generator to the compressors at approximately 8 p.s.i..  From the compressors the acetylene is pumped to the cylinders at between 200 and 300

p.s.i..   All of the cylinders contain a specific amount of acetone depending on the size of the cylinder being filled.  The acetone and acetylene chemically bond so that the acetylene is suspended in a stable condition for transport and use.   Because of the number of different size cylinders this facility can fill, the measurements taken were based on maximum potential size of the cylinders that are filled at the same time.

D.  The general accidental release prevention program and chemical-specific prevention steps:

The accidental release prevention program complies with OSHA-PSM, EPA-RMP, and NFPA regulations and guidelines.  Our facilities have multiple gas detectors set at 10% of the lower explosive limit (LEL). We have deluge sprinkler systems to mitigate a release of it occurred.

E.  The five year accident history:  

The five year accident history covers only certain releases (§68.42(a)):
1) The release must be from a covered process and involve a regulated substance held above its threshold quantity in the process.
2) The release must have caused at least one of the following:
a) On-site deaths, injuries, or significant property damage; or
b) Known offsite deaths, injuries, property damage, environmental damage, evacuations, or sheltering in place.

A review of the facilitys accident history showed that there have been no releases in the last five years that met the criteria above.

F.  The emergency response program:

Coordination of Emergency Response for this facility consists of tours taken by the local Fire Department to familiarize them with our facility and products.  The inventory information is also communicated to the Fire Dept and LEPC via Tier 2 reports.

All Western personnel receive training on emergency response.  Evacuation drills are conducted at least annually.  Monthly safety meetings are held for all employees.  Alert systems within the facility consist of word of mouth, an air horn, and by handheld cellular phones.

G.  Planned chan

ges to improve safety:

It is the intention of management and this company to continue to train and strive for excellence in the industrial gas business.  We believe that properly trained personnel are safe personnel and therefore we have no intentions of reducing the importance of safety.  Safety First will remain the policy for this company.
